articleTitle: Method for detection of non-relevant and wrong information based on content analysis of web resources
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In the article the methods, algorithms and architecture of software system to identify non-relevant and wrong information for online website of organization using the web semantic and content analysis are considered.

articleTitle: The video information resources integrity concept by using binomial slots
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper the urgency of using video information resources in state needs was considered. Disadvantages of modern imaging methods were analyzed. The concept of integrity with the redistribution of statistical codes is developed. Use floating coding scheme for forming fixed-length codes is proposed. Structural feature is included in the bit stream encoding. It is proposed to use the code generation feature for stream synchronization. This ensures localization of error propagation within the transforms. This leads to increased integrity.

articleTitle: Comparison of cost, material and time usage in FDM and SLS 3D printing methods
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Additive manufacturing (AM) is the process of joining materials to make objects from Computer Aided Design (CAD) model data, usually layer upon layer, as opposed to using subtractive manufacturing methods. The use of rapid prototyping technologies has increased significantly in recent years. This paper represents an attempt to answer the questions of when 3D printing can be used efficiently and of choosing the appropriate technology on the basis of batch size, element size, complexity, and time requirements.

articleTitle: Development of vibration spectrum analyzer using the Raspberry Pi microcomputer and 3-axis digital MEMS accelerometer ADXL345
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In the paper, the spectrum analyzer of vibration accelerations using the Raspberry Pi microcomputer and 3-axis digital MEMS ADXL345 accelerometer has been developed. The system includes accelerometer driver for Raspberry Pi, software for data acquiring and processing from the acceleration sensor, conversion of the vibration acceleration signals from time domain into frequency domain using DFT, graph plotting of the vibration accelerations and their spectra.

Author Keywords: Vibration acceleration monitoring and spectrum analysis system

articleTitle: Composing method of anti-interference codes based on non-equidistant structures
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The main problem considered in the article is the appearance of interferences in the information formed by increasing number of users of computer tech, high volume circulation of information, increasing value of digital information and increasing threats. The goal is to find anti-interference code that would be simple in construction and would have interference stability parameters not worse that known codes.

articleTitle: Mathematical modelling and method of investigation of the limiting equilibrium of an anisotropic cylindrical shell with crack
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The problem of stress state and limit equilibrium orthotropic cylindrical shell with an internal crack any configuration is reduced to a system of nonlinear singular integral equations. The algorithm of numerical solution of the resulting system is presented. The influence orthotropy load and geometrical parameters on cracks width and size of plastic zones near it are investigated.

articleTitle: Approximation accuracy of electromechanical systems high order objects using different types of fractional order transfer functions
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The approximation of high order transfer function using particle swarm optimization method through a range of proposed fractional order transfer functions (models) has been carried out and the accuracy of such approximation has been estimated by comparing transition and frequency characteristics. The advantages of transition function approximation of induction generator with self-excitation by using fractional order transfer functions have been elucidated.

articleTitle: Analysis of Cauchy criterion similarities in miniaturization of elastico-dynamic cantilever systems
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This paper discusses basic concepts of miniaturization of isometric elastic cantilever systems using Cauchy criterion.

articleTitle: The epidemiological approach to information security incidents forecasting for decision making systems
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Existing approaches to modeling epidemics in biological and the computer world are analyzed. Analogies and differences of epidemics in the biological and computer worlds were established. The obvious form of mathematical models for prediction of information and cyber-attacks dynamics was proposed. The latent period features of infections were analyzed. Opportunities of not destruction of alien objects in biological and computer systems were discussed. The conditions of deterministic chaos occurrence in the simulation are analyzed.

articleTitle: The method of providing of functional suitability of elements of the device of formation of signal in electrophysiological way of classification tissues surgical wound
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper the task of designing elements of the device of formation signal for electrophysiological method of classification tissues of surgical wound is considered. The method of providing functional suitability of these elements with simultaneous determination of tolerances on their parameters is proposed.

Author Keywords: classification tissues of the surgical wounds

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of mathematical models forming filter elements
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this article, the model using basic equations of filtration is demonstrated. In the article the basic equations that are used to construct a mathematical model of the process liquid filtration are obtained. The analysis of existing models of water filtration is reviewed, and the different processes of production of filter elements are analyzed.

articleTitle: Dynamic data processing for emergency monitoring by mobile devices
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The approaches and technologies of remote monitoring of a person in emergency by means smartphone were developed. Possible ways of data processing were analyzed for rising information capability of imperfect data. Neural network with one hidden layer was used for identification of person moving. Cross-entropy was used as a criterion.

articleTitle: Advanced approaches to reduce number of actors in a magnetically-operated wheel-mover of a mobile robot
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This paper considers ways to reduce the number of actors of a mobile robot (MR) based on a wheel-mover for moving on inclined and vertical ferromagnetic surfaces. Peculiarities of the magnetically-operated wheel-mover take into account at the developing mechanisms for movement control. Simulation models of the MR's wheel-mover moving on an arbitrary ferromagnetic surface with various control mechanisms are designed by the authors and proposed to be used for creating a real automatic control system for such MR's movers.

articleTitle: Information model of traction ability analysis of underground conveyors drives
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: We conducted an analysis of the traction ability of the drive of underground pipeline, the developed parametric information model is entered into the database of the characteristics of conveyors of different types. The software to handle the database and build interactive graphics based on the traction capacity of the traction coefficient was developed.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of dental implant insertion process
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The paper presents the results of the numerical simulation by finite element method of dental implant insertion into mandible.

articleTitle: Recruiting software architecture using user generated data
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper was developed and described high-level architecture of the software for recruiting and automatization of finding employees based on user generated data from social network LinkedIn. It described that for automatization of a big array of data of unstructured user generated data detailed ontology of domain “recruiting” should be developed; model of social media user in the context of his professional skills and improve the methodology for analyzing big data. High-level architecture of software based on LinkedIn API has been developed and it has few core elements: search spider, synonymous pre-processing, structured software part and ontology Storage.

articleTitle: Mechanical simulation of 3-axis accelerometer using a single proof-mass
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper we present the design of 3-axis accelerometer that consists of one proof-mass. It is a combination of classical comb-drive and flat electrode accelerometers. The suspension of such sensor was designed to allow the measurement in all axes. The 3D model was built and analyzed in Comsol. Mechanical behavior of the sensor was investigated and basic parameters were extracted such as eigenfrequency and the deflection in all axes under the acceleration up to 8 g. Moreover, cross-axis deflection was calculated.

articleTitle: Using reverse engineering and rapid prototyping for patient specific orthoses
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Orthotic devices are currently designed to fit a range of patients and therefore they do not provide individualized comfort and function. Using RP methods it is possible to make individual orthosis devices tailored to the individual patient and the disease also characterized by the modern design. A computerized technique for fabricating patient-specific orthotic devices has the potential to provide excellent comfort and allow for changes in the standard design to meet the specific needs of each patient. Reverse engineering methods are combined with rapid prototyping to create patient-specific orthoses. A novel process was engineered to utilize patient-specific surface data of the patient anatomy as a digital input, manipulate the surface data to an optimal form using CAD software, processing also for modern looking and check strength and then processing in rapid prototyping machine for fabrication. The article describes the utilization of rapid prototyping (RP), 3D scanning and software tools for the orthosis design process. This study shows the key points of the design and manufacturing methodology. The approach uses specific technologies, such as 3D digitizing, reverse engineering and polygonal-surface software, SLS RP and 3D printing.

articleTitle: Optimization of the particle vibration absorbers as SDOF systems
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The paper contemplates the provision of dynamic vibration absorber (DVA) with the few of the impact masses - impact damper (ID) or DVA with the small masses in the container -particle damper (PD). Such originally designed absorbers reduce vibration selectively in maximum vibration mode of electronic devices as MEMS, without introducing vibration in other modes. PD is a passive control device which takes the form of a freely moving masses or particles, constrained by stops attached to the structure under control, i.e. the primary structure. The damping results from the exchange of momentum during impacts among the masses and masses and stops as the structure vibrates. A technique is developed to give the optimal DVA's for the elimination of excessive vibration in harmonic stochastic and impact loaded systems as single degree-of-freedom (SDOF) buffered system.

articleTitle: Managing robot kinematics based on Arduino controllers using a Unity system
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This paper contains investigation on managing robot kinematics based on Arduino controllers using a Unity system. The developed system allows to perform different operations using the specially developed software to perform movement of the robotic arm and to define position objects into the certain positions.

articleTitle: Some trends in modern recommender systems
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper some trends in modern recommender systems are being investigated. It is shown that research in the field of recommender systems of the third generation is relevant. These systems are built on semantic models of knowledge representation.

articleTitle: Modeling methodology for knowledge-based systems of wells drilling control
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The proposed research is devoted to the problem of information models creation for intelligent control of wells drilling process through the relevant sensors derived parameters identification and feedback generation by the changes of the drilling environment through the modification of controlled variables for relevant process actuators under the imposed constraints.

articleTitle: Synthesis of a microelectronic structure of a specialized processor for sorting an array of binary numbers
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Methods for graphical representation of algorithms of sorting arrays of binary numbers were analyzed. Improved schematic solution for structure development and components of specialized processor for sorting an array of binary numbers by “bubbles” method was represented. As a result, high-performance structures of specialized processors for sorting an array of binary numbers on FPGA were synthesized. System characteristics of hardware and time complexity of this class of processors targeted at microelectronic implementation in structure of embedded systems were calculated.

Author Keywords: Specialized processor for sorting arrays of data

articleTitle: Research of electrocardiography sensors for healthcare monitoring
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper recent concepts in the area of electrography is presented. The problem of modern ECG devices is considered. The solution to the problem is proposed. A comparison of the known ECG sensors was carried out.

articleTitle: Emulation of programming environment for single-board computer Raspberry Pi at Monitoring the recurrent laryngeal nerve
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper the emulations of module for identification the recurrent laryngeal nerve by electrophysiological method via single board computer are given.

articleTitle: MEMS accelerometers classification using machine-learning methods
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: MEMS accelerometers classification with similar design and process parameters using machine-learning methods is proposed in the paper. A numerical experiment was performed. In it we investigated the possibilities of various machine-learning methods for solving classification task. The best results by accuracy parameter were obtained by Subspace KNN method.

articleTitle: Entropy estimation of investigated object state
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: For getting express information about different cases in engineering practice, medicines etc. nowadays often are used principles of the information theory. It is true as far as the behavior of the object under study is random. Recently, it is observed that the creation of a new system is frequently based on the employment of the entropy measure and permutation encoding. Such applications are known to be used for biometric systems, cryptography, body wireless networks and others. A concrete combination of active source addresses (with significant samples) may be considered as some generalized image of the object under study. It can be used as information for the control function of the next level of the cyber-physical system as well.

articleTitle: Dynamic properties and damping predictions for laminated micro-beams by different boundary conditions
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: During a few last decades importance of research of mechanical properties of thin plates of micro- or nano-dimension is multiplied due to their application in mikro electromechanics systems (MEMS) and nano electromechanics systems (NEMS). It is known that a surface of solid is a region with the thickness of a few atomic diameters, which have its own atomic structure and property which differs from a bulk. For a large solid with, because correlation of volume of external region to mass be small can ignore external effects. However, for small solids with large surface mass ratio effects grows. The main goal of this study is to predict the elastic and damping properties of composite laminated plates by various boundary conditions, simulating MEMS. This problem has an exact solution of the elasticity for simple homogeneous bends and conditions of lateral loading. This paper presents a new method for stress analysis for the accurate determination of detailed stress distributions in multilayer plates subjected to cylindrical bending. Here are some approximate methods for predicting the stress state for laminated plates. This method is adaptive and is not based on strict assumptions about the plate model. The described theoretical model includes the deformations of each layer of the plate, which take into account the effects of deformation of the transverse shear, transverse normal deformation, and nonlinear displacement changes with respect to the coordinate of thickness.

articleTitle: Extended active vibration control for wind turbines
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Minimizing the vibration, noise and shock is one of main tasks in designing rotating machinery, such as wind turbines, pumps, fans and centrifuges. A principal cause of vibration is unbalance of rotors due to either fabrication inaccuracies or operational factors. Unbalance leads to excessive wear on bearings and causes premature failures. Most common method to return the rotating element to a balanced condition is applying corrective masses at certain locations [1, 2]. Proposed methodology is based on unique Balancing System utilizing fluid as a corrective mass. In this work, we present a simulation of fluid flow through a designed device of the active balancing of rotors with correction mass (liquid). Proposed finite element calculations are based on model of ring with internal chambers, filled with fluid in controlled sequence.

articleTitle: The model of a light transmittance through translucent objects in lens-free imaging setups
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper the model of a light transmittance through translucent object inside lens-free imaging setup is presented.

articleTitle: Deep Learning researches in Turkey: An academic approach
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Deep learning (DL) is deployed in Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Deep Stacked Networks (DSNs), Deep Belief Networks (DBNs), and Deep Boltzmann Machines (DBMs). DL continues to take powerful steps to become a part of almost any software in the future. DL is one of the most popular research areas of machine learning. What makes it so popular is the exciting applications of recent times. Nowadays, improvement in machine learning provide ability to determine what an object in a picture does. The aim of this study is to reveal academic studies in the field of Deep Learning in Turkey and to evaluate their numerical results. Dataset search for studies in the field of DL were done in both the YÖKSIS database in Turkey and the internationally operated Web of Science and Scopus services. Finally, some evaluations were made to emphasize the importance of DL for the country.

articleTitle: Problems of testing of a highly specialized software
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this work the problems that arise when testing developed highly specialized software are considered. They were developed by students and teachers of different universities. The analysis, based on the example of TERMET, expediency of automated testing in developed educational or research systems, was performed. This system is used for manufacturing individual MEMS technologies.

articleTitle: Study of the high-pressure abrasive water jet cutting potential on the example of aluminum 2017
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The paper presents the results of the research of cutting potential, a relatively new technology that is a high-pressure water jet cutting during the cutting of aluminum 2017. The research was preceded by preparation of an appropriate experiment plan, which was also presented. In addition, the methodology of the study was presented. The results show that there is a need for further research in this area, in particular for the various types of materials, metal and non-metallic.

articleTitle: Acoustical performance of layered beams in the lower frequency range
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This study aims to predict the sound transmission properties of composite layered beams structures in the lower frequency range. In present paper a novel procedure to derive the sound isolation parameters for sandwich plates is under discussion. The main advantage of the present method is that it does not rely on strong assumptions about the model of the plate. The geometrical and mechanical parameters dependent frequency response functions and damping are presented for a three-layer beam. The effective stiffness constants of equivalent to lamina Timoshenko beam and their damping properties have been determined by using a procedure based on multi-level numerical schemes and eigenfrequencies comparison. Numerical evaluations obtained for the vibration of the equivalent Timoshenko beam have been used to determine the sound transmission properties of laminated composite beams with the system of DVA's. The optimization of beams - DVA's system sound absorption properties is performed in the low frequency range. The results have shown that the presence of a DVA causes a decrease in the sound transmission in the low-frequency range. The extension of the present approach to various layered plates with various DVA's systems will be performed in order to obtain optimal sound insulation. The optimization of layered plates - DVA's system sound absorption properties is performed in the low frequency range. The results have shown that the presence of a DVA causes a decrease in the sound transmission in the low-frequency range. The extension of the present approach to various layered plates with various DVA's systems will be performed in order to obtain optimal sound insulation.

articleTitle: The structure and components of embedded special processors for determination of entropy signals and random messages
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Theoretical bases, methods and special processor tools for determination entropy of random messages and signals are described. The analysis of entropy structures and special processors components oriented at microelectronic crystals performance is made. The scope of the theory of entropy data processing in various fields of knowledge and communications of law is defined.

articleTitle: Analysis of Electromyography Methods for Healthcare Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This work is dedicated to an analysis of existing electromyography methods. It was investigated that EMG-examination allows estimating the degree of muscle tension and the bioelectrical structure of generated tension, as well.

articleTitle: Implementation of opportunities of labview software package in case of design of electronic frequency synthesizer on the basis of PAAF
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Identified features that need to be considered when developing virtual appliances in a Lab VIEW environment. The simplest system of phase-locked loop with the indication of its disadvantages is given. Based on the software package Elanix SystemView complex LabVIEW built a model of frequency synthesizer based on PLL and for the given parameters and the division ratio of 5000 (the synthesized frequency is 2500 MHz), the system model was simulated on a time interval of 500 μs and at 3,075,782 sampling points. It was found that the spectrum of the signal in the region of the synthesized frequency as a whole approaches the spectrum of the harmonic signal, but it should be noted that parasitic harmonics are multiples of 50 kHz, and a low relative level of the useful signal is slightly more than 38 dBm.

articleTitle: Comparison energy cost wireless sensor networks built on two routing algorithms-Directed Diffusion and Geographic Adaptive Fidelity
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This article contains results of the comparison of the two routing algorithms - Directed Diffusion (hierarchical algorithm) and Geographic Adaptive Fidelity (algorithm based on clustering).

articleTitle: A generalized description of the weighted contrast
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper the problem of no-reference measurement of the contrast of image elements (objects and background) for complex multi-element images is considered. A generalized description of the weighted contrast of the image elements was proposed. New definitions for the weighted contrast of the image elements are proposed. A comparison of the proposed and known definitions of weighted contrast was carried out.

articleTitle: Decomposition of models of smart-home—Systems
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This article is devoted to the development of main decomposition levels for the specific models of smart-home systems, because such systems have a great extent of complexity, and need performing of their additional more detailed structural and functional decomposition.

articleTitle: The use of mobile technology on the example of health and sports statistics application
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Writing mobile application is very complex process. Programmer has to decide about lot of things. He has to choose best solution for him and application. The article describe example of tools kit which can be used in every project. It shows their advantages and benefits from using them. In next chapter described used technologies and showed their key properties. All solutions were chosen for mobile application for system Android. In last part showed application which was created using all before mentioned mechanism.

articleTitle: Parallel reduction of RLC-circuits
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper a parallel implementation of the RLC-circuit dimensions reduction algorithm based on the Y-Δ transformation is considered. The algorithm in question is based on the modified Sangiovanni-Vincentelli cluster algorithm. Simulation results are given, which prove efficiency of the proposed solution.

articleTitle: Project of structural solutions and components of special processor of relay protection in high-voltage lines of electricity transmission
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The information technology of designing structural solutions of relay protection special processor for high-voltage electricity transmission lines is presented. Existing means of relay protection based on hardware and software-hardware microprocessor controllers of digital protection are systematized. Special processor components are classified and their characteristics referring to 6 kV electricity transmission lines are substantiated.

Author Keywords: special processor of short circuits recognition

articleTitle: Estimation of low frequency electromagnetic values using machine learning
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: It is almost impossible to completely eliminate the effects of electromagnetic waves, but it is possible to reduce their effects. The use of machine learning is important to estimate these effects. Machine learning has been accelerating the upward trend over the last few years. It provides great advantages for problems that are difficult for human but easy to solve for machine. As a result, machine prediction is becoming increasingly popular. In this study, low frequency electromagnetic field values were measured in the buildings inside the campus and the output vector was tried to be estimated using machine learning. The results obtained by using linear regression, Gradient Descent (GD) algorithm and ridge regression models for estimation are evaluated.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic pollution measurement in the system rooms of a university
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Low frequency electromagnetic pollution is mostly caused by the transmission lines at 50 Hz in Turkey. Limit values for base stations and mobile phones are commonly known but there are also limit values for extremely low frequency (ELF) band. In this paper low frequency electromagnetic waves in system rooms of Mus Alparslan University are studied. Measured electromagnetic pollution compared with limit values and possible precautions examined.

articleTitle: Measurement and evaluation of low frequency electromagnetic field in camera observation rooms
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this study, low frequency electromagnetic field measurements (EMF) were performed in camera observation rooms and work offices at Mus Alparslan University. The electromagnetic measurements of the emitted values were measured with WP400 probe using SMP2 measuring device. The results obtained from different measurement points are compared by graphs.

articleTitle: Computer-aided design system of the interactive communication of the operator of computer-aided control of multiparameter object based on the image-cluster model
publicationTitle: 2017 XIIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This paper is devoted to the synthesis of image-cluster model of interactive monitoring of conditions of multiparameter objects on the basis of parallelized sensor processing data, identification statistical, correlational and cluster characteristics of technological processes. Structures of built-in special processors are described that are oriented on microelectronic implementation of crystals which actualized algorithms of integral processing of figures.
